jobs.title: Primis Business Development Manager
jobs.description: Careers – Work At Primis | primis Home Publishers Advertisers Content Resources Blog Insights Corner Product Center Company About Us News Events Careers Contact Login close Home / Careers / Business Development Manager Share Position: Business Development Manager Requirements At Primis, Business Development Managers are much more than traditional sales reps. They identify leads, build long term, high trust relationships, and navigate strategic business conversations with leading publishers worldwide. We are looking for a hungry, highly motivated and ambitious Junior Business Development Manager to join our team. This role requires high business acumen, sharp analytical thinking, and the resourcefulness to identify, reach out to, and engage key decision-makers with new publishers If you are passionate, eager to learn, and driven by results, we want to hear from you! Key Responsibilities Research and analyze a target list of digital publishers. Identify key stakeholders and execute creative, personalized outreach strategies. Truly understand publisher needs and pain points to position our solution effectively. Utilize analytical skills and data to compare metrics, demonstrate value, and showcase our video player's advantage over existing solutions. Develop strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers through active listening, deep industry understanding, and value-focused communication. Support the end-to-end sales process, from lead generation to closing, alongside senior team members. Partner closely with internal teams (Account Management, Technical Support, and Product) to ensure smooth onboarding and account growth. Requirements Curiosity and desire to grow into a full-cycle business development or sales role. Up to 1–2 years of hands-on experience in SDR / BDR / Sales or account management roles in a technology-oriented company - Advantage. High drive, self-motivated, and hungry to achieve results. Ability to understand business structures, identify key decision-makers, and communicate value effectively. Fluent/Native-level English (written and spoken) - Must. Exceptional interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence. Analytical Mindset: Strong comfort with numbers and data. Hands-on experience using HubSpot CRM - Advantage. Familiarity with the AdTech or digital publisher ecosystem - Advantage. So, are you ready to push for more? jobs.title: Primis Junior Publisher Success Manager
jobs.description: Careers – Work At Primis | primis Home Publishers Advertisers Content Resources Blog Insights Corner Product Center Company About Us News Events Careers Contact Login close Home / Careers / Junior Publisher Success Manager Share Position: Junior Publisher Success Manager Requirements A Bit About Us We are an ever-evolving company, driven by our passion for video. We’ve grown from a small start-up to a thriving business, and have been a part of the biggest global ad agency for ten years. Our main priority is maintaining our fun and determined environment and keeping our employees engaged in their work. About the Position The Publisher Success Manager will be an integral part of the Publisher Success team and will work closely with some of the company's key clients and partners. In this role, you will be responsible for providing top-tier service to publishers, ensuring retention, and driving growth in their monetization performance. You will assist team members and managers in delivering data-driven insights and operational excellence while collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize results. This is an exciting opportunity to join a leading tech company, work with major digital publishers, and grow within a fast-paced, data-driven environment. Main Responsibilities: Manage and nurture relationships with publishers, ensuring long-term partnerships and client satisfaction. Provide ongoing support to Primis publisher accounts, ensuring smooth daily operations and a high level of service. Monitor and analyze reports to track performance, identify trends, and provide actionable insights to the team and management. Assist in managing publisher-related tasks and operations, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in execution. Facilitate cross-team collaboration, coordinating between departments such as Tech, Product, and Sales to optimize publisher success. Develop a strong understanding of the Adtech industry, with a focus on ad revenue generation publisher monetization and digital advertising strategies. Requirements Fluent English (spoken, written, and reading) – must be able to communicate effectively with international clients. Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Business, Economics, or a related field. Strong analytical mindset – ability to read, interpret, and extract insights from reports and data. Proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets (including Pivot Tables & VLOOKUP) – must be comfortable analyzing data and deriving action items. Excellent time management and multitasking skills – ability to handle multiple accounts, a wide range of tasks, and responsibilities simultaneously. Highly motivated, organized, and detail-oriented – thrives in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities. Self-learner with a growth mindset – eager to learn and develop expertise in the video ad-tech industry. Strong interpersonal and communication skills – able to build and maintain relationships with clients and collaborate across teams. A true team player – works well within a team and with cross-functional departments. Experience in digital advertising - big advantage So, are you ready to push for more? jobs.title: Primis Product Manager
jobs.description: Careers – Work At Primis | primis Home Publishers Advertisers Content Resources Blog Insights Corner Product Center Company About Us News Events Careers Contact Login close Home / Careers / Product Manager Share Position: Product Manager Requirements Every hour, video experiences built by our product team run across Washington Post, AP News, Reach PLC, Sinclair, and hundreds of other publishers. When you ship something here, you see it in the revenue numbers the same day - and so do the publishers who depend on it. We are looking for a sharp, tech-savvy, and highly motivated Product Manager to join our Product team. If you are passionate about creating video experiences that impact millions of people every hour, eager to learn, and always push for more, Primis is the right place for you! Your Role Lead and own multiple products and features within the Primis product suite throughout their lifecycle. From initial concept to product requirements to execution and adoption. Work directly with high profile clients and users on a daily basis to gather their needs and feedback about our products. Collaborate with engineering, sales and customer success teams to build high-quality products and deliver them to our clients. Analyze feature performance and iterate until business needs are met and customer satisfaction is reached. Requirements 4+ years in B2B product management, ideally on technical or platform products. Comfort with APIs, integrations, and system architecture – enough to design with engineers, not just around them. Developed product taste and track record of building easy to use products. Hands-on experience with AI tools, leveraging AI to move faster and make better product decisions. Agile (in mindset and methodologies) yet very organized and structured. Fluent English, verbal and written. AdTech or online media background – significant advantage Experience with video delivery or player technology – significant advantage Primis is an ever-evolving Ad-Tech company that grew from a startup into part of McCann and Omnicom Group. So, are you ready to push for more?
